parameters.name: PasswordForcedUpdateStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable forcible password change upon first logon. Valid values:

*   enabled
*   disabled

parameters.name: PasswordInitializationNotificationChannels
parameters.description: The methods for receiving password initialization notifications.

parameters.name: PasswordInitializationStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable password initialization. Valid values:

*   enabled
*   disabled

parameters.name: PasswordInitializationType
parameters.description:
The password initialization method. This parameter is required when PasswordInitializationStatus is set to enabled. Set the value to random.

*   random: A randomly generated password is used.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam set-password-initialization-configuration --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --password-initialization-status enabled --password-initialization-type random --password-forced-update-status enabled --password-initialization-notification-channels email --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam SetPasswordInitializationConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --PasswordInitializationType random --PasswordForcedUpdateStatus enabled --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --PasswordInitializationNotificationChannels.1 email --PasswordInitializationStatus enabled --method POST --force
